{{Quote|Unleash the Trident Drills!|Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], commanding battle droids at the Battle of Kamino|<ref name="VG">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
The '''''Trident''-class assault ship''', more commonly known as the '''Trident drill assault craft''' or simply the '''Trident drill''', was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] drilling [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used for stealthy, underwater assaults, as used in the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] and the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|second battle of Mon Calamari]] during the Clone Wars.

==Characteristics==
[[File:TridentDrills-ARCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Trident drills clamber onto Tipoca City.]]
The ''Trident''-class assault ship was inspired by an [[Unidentified Gree Enclave droid model|ancient design]] from the remote [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. A modifiable [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] carrier with aquatic capability, the ''Trident'' was equipped with eight [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], four powerful mechanical arms, and a [[drill-spike]] that could be swapped out for a powerful [[Engine/Legends|engine]] for long-distance and [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel. It was fitted with two primary observation portals and eight secondary ones along its "head," while its arms were encased by thick [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and equipped with [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] grapples.<ref name="TCW Incredible Vehicles" />

==History==
The ships were used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] employed a ''Trident''-class assault ship eponymously named the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']], which she used in the kidnapping of [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] prior to the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle]] of [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].

[[File:TridentDrill.png|thumb|right|200px|''Trident''-class assault ships employ their drill-spikes.]]
The ships were partially disassembled and attached to parts of Separatist [[Transport/Legends|transports]] during the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|space battle]] above [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and when [[Starship/Legends|starships]] like Separatist [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] were blown apart by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] forces protecting the planet, the debris fell through the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and into the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] surrounding [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]]. [[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droids]] were deployed and assembled them underwater. After the drilling ships were completely assembled, they rose from the ocean and attacked the city. The opposing [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] could not damage the drills with their normal [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15Ss]], [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], or [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]], but the drills were severely damaged towards the end of the battle when the clones used [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. The battle was eventually lost by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

The ships were later used during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|second battle of Mon Calamari]] as troop deployment craft, patrol ships, and assault ships with one ship acting as [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson's]] command ship. They were used first to release large amounts of Aqua droids. After the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] civilians were rounded up and taken to prison camps the ships were then used to patrol the waters surrounding the city. When the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] came as the Republic's reinforcements, Tamson used the ships to create whirlpools which sucked up anyone in the surrounding waters except Tamson and his aqua droids. After the Mon Calamari, [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], Gungans, and Republic forces sided together to fight the Separatists, the ships were used to simply ram enemy targets in the water and would plow through formations of the allied troops. However, some of the Mon Cala fighters and Gungan warriors used their weapons to punch holes in the port holes of one of the drills causing water to run into the hull and destroying the drill.

==Behind the scenes==
There appear to be two different variants of the ship seen in the show. A small version that is used by Asajj Ventress and a much larger version that is used on both Kamino and Mon Calamari. The smaller version also appears along side its larger variant on Mon Calamari where they are used to create a whirlpool by swimming around one of the larger ones.
